messages:
maria: Quick heads-up: Zephyr2-int4 canary showed ~12% structured-output parse failures on our schema-eval set. Full sample below.
jamal: ugh, can you paste an example?
maria: ```json
{"action": "create", "params": {"id": 123,},}
``` 
alex: trailing comma + extra wrapper. Also keys out of order — parsers are strict. Try stripping trailing commas first.
eva: we saw similar with Sparrow-lite int8. Option: soft-schema parser that tolerates single quotes, trailing commas, numeric->string coercion.
canary-bot: Canary run 2026-03-20T15:22Z: Zephyr2-int4 parse_success=88%, fp16 baseline parse_success=98%
devops-bot: cost delta to fall back to fp16 is ~2.3x tokens. Not great for 24/7.
jamal: ran a tiny probe (n=200) with heuristics: native parse 86%, json-repair then parse 95%, heuristic-squeeze postprocess 97% (saves fallback)
maria: what's 'heuristic-squeeze'?
jamal: simple steps: remove trailing commas, normalize quotes, coerce numeric-like strings -> numbers when schema expects number, stable key ordering. Implemented in ~40 LOC python.
alex: can you paste the script?
jamal: ```python
# heuristic-squeeze (excerpt)
import re, json
# strip trailing commas before } and ]
s = re.sub(r",\s*(\]|\})", r"\1", s)
# normalize quotes
s = s.replace("'", '"')
# lightweight schema-guided coercion (pseudo)
# if schema says number and value looks numeric, cast to number
``` 
eva: nice. two asks: 1) run full 1k eval vs baseline int8/float16 and report parse_success + semantic fidelity (QA-match). 2) add this as a pre-parse stage in canary only (no permanent fallback)
maria: agreed. I'll queue a canary job. Plan: run 1k, compare parse_success + rolling average accept rate. If heuristic-squeeze increases parse_success to >=97% and semantic-fidelity drop <1%, we keep int4 with postprocess. Otherwise rollback.
alex: also log cases where repair changes semantic meaning (need sample diff).
jamal: logging added (diff + original output saved to s3: s3://canary-logs/zephyr2/1713605123/).
maria: timeline: run starts in 30m, ETA ~2h. I'll post results.
canary-bot: Job queued: canary/zephyr2-int4/heuristic-squeeze/1713605123
maria: thanks :thumbsup:
